blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing adversarial fine-tuning methods often use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image--text alignment while improving robustness. Our analysis of visual representation drift reveals complementary limitations of two representative forms of guidance. Matching visual features provides broad coverage by constraining all directions equally, but lacks semantic emphasis. Matching prediction distributions prioritizes semantically relevant directions, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities. These limitations can hinder preservation of pre-trained image--text relationships and degrade zero-shot performance. To address these issues, we propose Textual Response-Aware Guidance (TRAG), which constrains visual representation drift using the pre-trained text encoder's responses to local variations in input embeddings. Specifically, TRAG constructs anchor-level constraints from the response directions and magnitudes around semantic anchors, then aggregates them using pre-trained image--anchor relevance, yielding an image-adaptive constraint. Extensive experiments across architectures and tasks demonstrate state-of-the-art clean and robust performance. Further analysis shows that TRAG helps preserve pre-trained image--text relationships.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)表现出强烈的零射通俗化,但仍然容易受到对抗攻击. 现有的对抗性微调方法往往使用经过预先训练的模型指导来保持图像-文本相接,同时提高稳健性. 我们对视觉表现漂移的分析表明,两种有代表性的指导形式具有互补性的局限性。 相匹配的视觉特征通过平等地约束所有方向提供了广泛的覆盖,但缺乏语义上的重点. 相匹配的预测分布会优先确定与目的相关的方向,但仍然受到候选文本和预测概率的限制. 这些限制会妨碍预训图像-文本关系的保存并降低零镜头性能. 为了解决这些问题,我们提出了文字反应-智能指导(TRAG),它利用预先训练的文字编码器对输入嵌入中局部变化的响应来限制视觉表现漂移. 具体地说,TRAG从反应方向和大小上围绕语义锚地构建了锚层约束,再用预先训练的图像-锚地相关性来进行聚合,产生出图像-适应性约束. 跨越建筑和任务的广泛实验显示了最先进的清洁而有力的性能. 进一步的分析表明,TRAG有助于保存预先训练的图像-文本关系.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Vision-language models (VLMs) [ 32 , 47 ] achieve strong zero-shot generalization through large-scale pre-training on image–text pairs.
By aligning visual and textual representations in a shared embedding space, VLMs support applications such as image classification [ 51 ] and image–text retrieval [ 16 ] , and provide visual backbones for large vision-language models (LVLMs) [ 23 ] .
However, similar to conventional deep neural networks [ 38 , 9 ] , VLMs remain vulnerable to adversarial examples.
Small, carefully crafted image perturbations can induce incorrect predictions, undermining model reliability [ 49 , 50 ] .
Adversarial fine-tuning improves robustness but can compromise zero-shot generalization [ 27 ] .
A central challenge is therefore to preserve the pre-trained image–text alignment underlying zero-shot transfer while improving adversarial robustness.
blocks.zh:
Vision-language models (VLMs) [32,47]通过图像-文本对接的大规模预训,实现强零镜头通化.
VLM通过在共享嵌入空间中对视觉和文字表现进行对接,支持图像分类[51]和图像-文本检索[16]等应用,为大型视觉语言模型(LVLM)提供视觉骨干[23].
然而,与常规的深神经网络相类似[38,9],VLM仍然容易受到对抗性例子的影响.
小而精心设计的图像扰动可诱发不正确的预测,破坏模型可靠性[49.,50].
逆向微调能提高稳健性,但能损害零发通化[27].
因此,一个中心挑战是保持经过事先训练的图像——零发转让背后的文本相接,同时提高对抗力。

blocks.en:
Existing methods often use guidance from the pre-trained model to preserve image–text alignment during adversarial fine-tuning.
Some match visual features between the fine-tuned and pre-trained models [ 34 , 42 ] , whereas others match prediction distributions over candidate texts [ 40 , 5 ] .
Both forms of guidance aim to preserve pre-trained image–text relationships, which depend on projections of visual representations along different directions in the shared embedding space.
For normalized representations, projections onto textual representations determine individual image–text similarities, while projections onto differences between textual representations determine relative similarities [ 32 ] .
Changes in visual representations along different directions can affect these relationships differently.
How guidance constrains these changes can therefore influence the preservation of image–text relationships.
blocks.zh:
现有方法往往使用预先训练过的模型的指导,在对抗性微调时保存图像-文本对齐.
一些与经过微调的模型和预先训练的模型相匹配的视觉特征[34,42],而另一些则与候选文本的预测分布相匹配[40,5].
这两种指导形式都旨在保留预先训练过的图像-文本关系,这种关系取决于对共享嵌入空间不同方向的视觉表现的预测.
对于规范化的表达方式,对文本表达方式的预测决定了单个图像-文本的相似性,而对文本表达方式之间的差异的预测则决定了相对的相似性[32].
不同方向的视觉表现的变化可以对这些关系产生不同的影响.
因此,指导如何限制这些变化会影响图像-文本关系的保存。

blocks.en:
From this perspective, we analyze both forms of guidance as directional constraints on drift from pre-trained visual representations, revealing complementary limitations.
As illustrated in Figs. 1 1(a) and 1 1(b) , matching visual features constrains drift equally in all directions, providing broad coverage but no semantic emphasis.
Matching prediction distributions instead prioritizes semantically relevant directions associated with differences between candidate textual representations, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities.
Zero-shot generalization, however, requires preserving diverse image–text relationships across unseen tasks.
These limitations can leave such relationships insufficiently protected and degrade zero-shot performance.
We therefore seek directional references for potential semantic variations to construct guidance with broad coverage and semantic emphasis.
blocks.zh:
从这个角度出发,我们分析两种指导形式,作为对从预先训练的视觉表现来漂移的方向性限制,揭示出互补的局限性.
如图11(a)和图1(b)所示,相匹配的视觉特征制约着所有方向的漂移,提供了广泛的覆盖面,但没有强调语义。
匹配预测分布则优先考虑与候选人文字表述差异相关的明显相关方向,但仍受到候选人文本和预测概率的限制。
但是,零镜头的通俗化需要保护各种图像-文字关系,贯穿于不可见的任务。
这些限制可能使这种关系得不到足够的保护并会降低零发性能。
因此,我们为潜在的语义变化寻求方向性参考,以构建具有广泛覆盖面和语义重点的指导。

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we propose T extual R esponse- A ware G uidance ( TRAG ), which uses local responses of the pre-trained text encoder to constrain visual representation drift.
Using known texts as semantic anchors, we examine its responses to local variations in their input embeddings.
As shown in Fig. 1 1(c) , the response directions and magnitudes characterize local changes in textual representations, providing directional references for potential semantic variations beyond the given texts.
With a fixed total weight for directional penalties, we derive anchor-level constraints by minimizing the average worst-case error in preserving image–text relationships associated with these local changes.
Finally, we aggregate them using pre-trained image–anchor relevance on clean images, yielding an image-adaptive constraint for adversarial fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
为了克服这些限制,我们提议采用T extual R esponse-A ware G uidance(TRAG),即使用预先训练过的文本编码器的本地反应来限制视觉表现漂移.
使用已知的文本作为语义锚,我们考察了它对其输入嵌入中局部变化的反应.
如图1 1 (c)所示,反应方向和规模是当地在文字表述上变化的特点,为特定文字之外的潜在语义变化提供了方向参考。
用固定的定向处罚总权重,我们通过最小化与这些本地变化相关的保存图像-文本关系的平均最坏错误来得出锚级约束。
最后,我们用预先训练过的图像—— 与清洁图像的关联性—— 来加以汇总,从而产生一种图像适应性约束,用于对抗性的微调。

blocks.en:
Extensive experiments demonstrate TRAG’s state-of-the-art clean and robust performance.
We validate these advantages across multiple VLM architectures on zero-shot classification and image–text retrieval, covering both class-supervised and image–text fine-tuning settings under multiple threat models.
These benefits extend to image captioning and visual question answering in LVLMs.
Further analyses and ablations show that TRAG helps preserve pre-trained image–text relationships during robust adaptation.
Our main contributions are as follows: • We analyze the directional constraints that feature matching and prediction distribution matching impose on visual representation drift, revealing complementary limitations in preserving pre-trained image–text relationships. • We propose TRAG, which derives anchor-level constraints from local responses of the pre-trained text encoder and aggregates them using image–anchor relevance, yielding an image-adaptive constraint. • We demonstrate state-of-the-art clean and robust performance across architectures and tasks, with analyses and ablations showing that TRAG helps preserve pre-trained image–text relationships.

这些好处扩展到图像标题和LVLMs的视觉问题回答.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Adversarial robustness of VLMs. Adversarial attacks can induce incorrect predictions in deep neural networks through small, carefully crafted image perturbations, posing security risks [ 38 , 9 ] .
Adversarial training is a widely adopted defense that uses min–max optimization to improve robustness, alternating between generating adversarial examples against the current model and updating its parameters [ 25 ] .
For VLMs, TeCoA [ 27 ] fine-tunes the image encoder with a text-guided contrastive objective to improve zero-shot adversarial robustness.
Subsequent methods increase separation between class textual representations [ 19 ] or adjust classification margins [ 24 ] .
Other approaches align regions along adversarial paths [ 7 ] or image–text subspaces [ 6 ] .
Adversarial prompt learning optimizes textual prompts [ 17 ] or both textual and visual prompts [ 52 ] while keeping the pre-trained encoders fixed.
Test-time defenses improve inference robustness through prompt tuning [ 36 , 41 ] or input counterattacks [ 45 ] .
blocks.zh:
VLMs的反常稳健性. 横向攻击可能通过小而精心设计的图像扰动在深层神经网络中诱发不正确的预测,造成安全风险[38,9].
对抗性训练是一种被广泛采纳的辩护方法,它使用分钟-最大优化来提高稳健性,在产生与当前模式相对抗的对抗性例子和更新其参数之间交替进行. [25].
对于VLMs,TeCoA [27]微调了图像编码器,使其具有以文字为取向的对比性目标来改进零镜头对抗力.
随后的方法会增加类正文表述之间的分化[19]或调整分级幅度[24].
其他方法使区域沿着对抗路径[7]或图像-文本子空间[6]。
逆向即时学习优化了文字提示[17],或者既能实现文字提示又能实现视觉提示[52],同时保持了被预先训练的编码器的固定.
试验时防御通过即时调制[36,41]或输入反攻[45]来提高推论强度.

blocks.en:
Pre-trained model guidance. To mitigate degradation in zero-shot generalization, existing methods use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image–text alignment during adversarial fine-tuning.
At the feature level, FARE [ 34 ] matches adversarial visual features to the pre-trained model’s clean features.
QT-AFT [ 42 ] combines feature matching with richer textual supervision from high-quality image captions.
At the prediction level, PMG-AFT [ 40 ] combines an adversarial task objective with prediction distribution matching against the pre-trained model.
AGFT [ 5 ] replaces hard-label supervision with the pre-trained model’s soft alignment distributions, calibrated through temperature scaling.
TGA-ZSR [ 48 ] preserves text-guided spatial attention using the original model as a reference.
AdvFLYP [ 44 ] combines contrastive adversarial fine-tuning on web image–text pairs with feature matching and prediction distribution matching.
We analyze the directional constraints imposed by representative feature and prediction distribution matching objectives.
TRAG uses local responses of the pre-trained text encoder to construct an image-adaptive constraint on visual representation drift.
blocks.zh:
预训示范指导. 为了减轻零镜头通缩中的降解,现有方法使用预先训练过的模型指导,在对抗性微调时保存图像-文本对齐.
在特征层面,FARE[34]将对抗性视觉特征与预训模型的清洁特征相匹配.
QT-AFT [42] 将特性与更丰富的文字监督结合,从高质量的图像标题.
在预测层面,PMG-AFT[40]结合了对抗性任务目标与预测分布与预训模型相匹配.
AGFT [5] 以预训模型的软对接分布来取代硬标签监督,通过温度缩放来校正.
TGA-ZSR [48] 保留了以原始模型为参考的文本引导空间注意.
AdvFLYP [44] 在网页图像上结合了对比性对抗性的微调-文本对和特征匹配和预测分布匹配.
我们分析代表性特征和预测分布匹配目标带来的方向限制。
TRAG使用被预训文本编码器的局部响应来构建出对视觉表现漂移的图像适应约束.

blocks.en: 3 Preliminaries and Analysis
blocks.zh: 3 初步和分析

blocks.en:
We introduce the basic setting and analyze how two representative forms of pre-trained guidance constrain visual representation drift.
Geometric diagnostics further examine their complementary limitations and inform guidance for preserving diverse image–text relationships.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍基本环境,分析两种具有代表性的预先训练出的指导形式如何限制视觉表现漂移。
几何诊断法进一步审查了其互补性局限性,并为维护多种图像-文本关系提供指导。

blocks.en: 5.1 Zero-Shot Image Classification
blocks.zh: 5.1 零热图像分类

blocks.en:
Experimental setup. We fine-tune CLIP ViT-B/32 on ImageNet [ 33 ] and evaluate on ImageNet and 15 zero-shot datasets: Caltech-101 [ 8 ] , Caltech-256 [ 11 ] , CIFAR-10 [ 15 ] , CIFAR-100 [ 15 ] , DTD [ 2 ] , EuroSAT [ 12 ] , FGVC Aircraft [ 26 ] , Flowers102 [ 28 ] , Food-101 [ 1 ] , ImageNet-R [ 13 ] , ImageNet-S [ 39 ] , Oxford-IIIT Pet [ 30 ] , Stanford Cars [ 14 ] , STL-10 [ 3 ] , and SUN397 [ 43 ] .
Unless otherwise stated, training and evaluation use an ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} budget of 2 / 255 2/255 .
For TRAG, we use five epochs, 5-step PGD with step size 1 / 255 1/255 , and λ = 15 \lambda=15 .
The 1,000 ImageNet class names serve as anchors.
blocks.zh:
实验设置. 我们在ImageNet上微调CLIP ViT-B/32,并在ImageNet和15个零镜头数据集上评价:Caltech-101 [8],Caltech-256 [11],CIFAR-10 [15],CIFAR-100 [15],DTD [2],EuroSAT [12],FGVC飞机 [26],花儿102 [28],Food-101 [1],ImageNet-R [13],ImageNet-S [39],Oxford-IIIT Pet [30],斯坦福汽车 [14],STL-10 [3],和SUN397 [43].
除非另有说明,训练和评价使用的预算为2 / 2552/255。
对于TRAG,我们使用5个纪元,5个步骤的PGD,并有1/2551/255的步号;而QQ=15\lambda=15.
1000个ImageNet类名称作为锚.

blocks.en:
We reproduce TeCoA [ 27 ] , PMG-AFT [ 40 ] , FARE [ 34 ] , TGA-ZSR [ 48 ] , QT-AFT [ 42 ] , and AGFT [ 5 ] using their respective training configurations.
All methods share the evaluation protocol.
Following FARE in attack selection, we use APGD-CE and targeted APGD-DLR from AutoAttack [ 4 ] , with 20 iterations each.
We report per-dataset accuracy and averages across the 16 datasets.
Further details are provided in the appendix.

所有方法都共享评价协议.
在FARE进行攻击选择后,我们使用APGD-CE,并瞄准来自AutoAttack的APGD-DLR[4],各有20个迭代.

blocks.en:
Main results. Table 1 shows that TRAG achieves the highest average clean and robust accuracy among fine-tuned methods: 59.60% and 35.09%, respectively.
These exceed the strongest baseline for each metric by 2.51 and 1.49 percentage points.
TRAG leads on 11 datasets for clean accuracy and 12 for robust accuracy, covering both ImageNet and zero-shot benchmarks.
For instance, TRAG improves CIFAR-100 clean and robust classification accuracy over AGFT by 4.10 and 2.82 percentage points, respectively.

Pre-trained constraints. We replace TRAG with FM, DM, and two combinations under the same fine-tuning pipeline.
Table 8 compares a trace-normalized FM–DM quadratic mix and a direct FM+DM loss, with coefficients and search ranges detailed in the appendix.
The mixtures approach TRAG’s robust accuracy but yield lower clean accuracy.
Against the quadratic mix with λ = 10 \lambda=10 , TRAG gains 2.27 points in clean accuracy with nearly unchanged robust accuracy (35.09% vs. 35.05%).

被训练有素的束缚 我们把TRAG替换为调频,DM,以及在同一微调管下的两个组合.
表8比较了微量常态FM-DM四相混合和直接FM+DM损失,系数和搜索范围详见附录.
混合物接近TRAG的强精度,但净精度较低。
与QQ=10\lambda=10的四相混合,TRAG以近乎不变的强精度(35.09%对35.05%)获得2.27分的纯精度.

Directional weight spectra. Figure 4 complements the constraint ablations with eigenvalue spectra before fine-tuning.
After trace normalization, FM assigns equal weights, DM concentrates its weights in relatively few directions, and TRAG distributes them more broadly while retaining nonuniform penalties.
These spectra illustrate constraint structure without directly predicting robustness.
blocks.zh:
方向重量谱. 图4在微调前用等位值光谱来补充制约。
在微量正常化后,调频分配等分权重,DM将其权重集中在相对较少的方向上,TRAG在保留非统一处罚的同时进行更广泛的分配.
这些光谱说明了制约结构,但没有直接预测稳健性.

blocks.en:
Relationship preservation. We examine 64 images per zero-shot dataset using clean inputs and adversarial candidates retained without fallback to the original image.
Relative to the pre-trained clean reference, we measure feature drift, the variance of class-similarity changes weighted by pre-trained probabilities, and retention of originally correct predictions.
The variance measures changes in pairwise class relationships; diagnostic details are provided in the appendix.
Table 9 shows that TRAG allows greater feature drift than FM and the quadratic mix while preserving these relationships better, both before and after attack.
DM has slightly lower adversarial relationship error (11.07 vs. 11.22), while TRAG’s prediction retention is numerically higher (42.66% vs. 41.97%); these differences remain within sampling uncertainty.
Relationship preservation does not imply robustness.
blocks.zh:
关系维护. 我们用干净的输入和对抗性候选人来检查每组零发数据集的64个图像,而不回溯到原始图像。
相对于预受训练的清洁参考,我们测量了特征漂移,以预受训练的概率加权的同级变化相差,以及保留了原本正确的预测.
差异衡量成对类关系的变化;诊断细节载于附录。
表9显示,TRAG允许比调频和四相混音更大的特性漂移,同时在攻击前后更好地维护这些关系.
DM的对抗关系误差略低(11.07对11.22),而TRAG的预测保留率在数字上更高(42.66%对41.97%);这些差异仍然在抽样不确定性之内.
维护关系并不意味着牢固。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented TRAG, which guides adversarial fine-tuning of VLMs using local responses of the pre-trained text encoder.
Our analysis reveals complementary limitations of feature and prediction-distribution matching.
TRAG constructs anchor-level constraints from response directions and magnitudes, then aggregates them by image–anchor relevance to constrain visual representation drift.
Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art clean and robust performance in zero-shot classification and cross-modal retrieval, with robustness benefits extending to LVLMs.
Ablations and posterior diagnostics support preserving pre-trained image–text relationships while allowing adaptation.
Local responses remain proxies for potential concept variations, and relationship preservation alone does not characterize robustness.
TRAG thus provides a practical way to use pre-trained text knowledge for robust visual adaptation without additional inference cost.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了TRAG,它用预先训练过的文本编码器的局部反应来指导 VLM 的对抗性微调.
我们的分析揭示了特征和预测分布匹配的互补性局限性。
TRAG从反应方向和规模中构建起锚级约束,然后按照图像-锁定相关性加以汇总,以限制视觉表现漂移.
实验展示了零发分级分类和跨模式取用中最先进的清洁和稳健的性能,稳健性效益扩展到了LVLM.
校对和后诊断支持保留预先训练的图像-文本关系,同时允许适应。
当地的反应仍然是潜在概念变化的代名词,单是关系维护并不能成为稳健性的特点。
因此,TRAG提供了一种实用的方法,在不增加推论费用的情况下,使用经过预先训练的文字知识来进行强健的视觉改造.
